messages:
mina: Quick follow-up to the compat RFC. Proposal: an X-Compat-Cap header clients may send during handshake to declare their supported surfaces. We cache per-tenant (12h TTL) and use it for routing decisions so we don't pay detection cost on every request. Thoughts?

devin: I like caching. 12h TTL seems ok but what about ops toggles? we need an admin override and a purge endpoint.

tara: agree on override. Also: header authenticity is a concern. Can we HMAC the header with the API key secret so routers can validate? otherwise anyone could claim modern-capabilities.

ryan: HMAC is doable but adds CPU cost at ingress. Alternative: tie the header to API key metadata stored in our control plane (clients claim capability, control plane verifies once and stamps tenant metadata). cheaper at runtime.

mina: good point. let's verify at first-seen handshake in control plane, then issue a short-lived signed cookie the router can validate cheaply. verification path: header -> control plane validate -> router gets signed token. TTL 12h by default, operator adjustable.

devin: shim behavior: For tenants without a valid token, ingress will either rewrite legacy envelope to new body (cheap lua) or route to a translator sidecar for heavyweight cases (streams). Important: mark transformed requests with header `X-Compat-Transformed: 1` and `compat.metric_group`.

tara: streaming: we cannot safely auto-rewrite streaming envelopes without loss. Solution: only auto-transform non-streaming endpoints. For streaming, either require client opt-in or run a translator that understands chunk boundaries and maps events.

ryan: metrics: emit `shim.cpu_ms`, `shim.latency_p50/p99`, `shim.errors`, and `compat.output_drift_ratio`. Add tenant-level quota for shim concurrency and a backpressure flag `compat.quarantine` if tenant exceeds error gate.

mina: rollout plan: small cohorts: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> opt-in. Each step gated on latency, error-rate, and drift. If transform failure rate > 0.1% or output drift > 0.5% trigger rollback for cohort.

devin: ops automation: auto-generate simple shim rules for schema diffs (rename/move/un-envelop) using our schema-diff tool. It can emit an Envoy lua snippet or a tiny transform lambda. Put generator in repo `infra/compat-gen` and run on schema change PRs.

tara: testing: add fuzz tests for envelope permutations and contract tests for streamed boundary cases. Also include golden-file comparison for sampled transformed responses (1% sampling). Store samples in GCS.

ryan: cost accounting: tag transformed tokens with `billing.compat_overhead` so we can attribute extra cost to shim work and decide whether to bill enterprise tenants for heavy translation.

mina: security: ensure control-plane verification rate-limits validate calls to avoid amplification. Also log header mismatches to `sec.audit` for suspicious attempts.

rollout-bot: scheduled job started: `compat-probe/sandbox-translate` (job id 20260301-7) :gear:

mina: Action items: @devin implement token issuance + purge API (due Mon). @ryan add shim metrics + quarantine flag (due Tue). @tara start schema-diff generator spike and stream test harness (P1). I'll update RFC with playbook and add rollback signals to the runbook.

devin: noted. will also stub admin UI for override.

tara: starting the test harness now. will post results to the thread.

mina: thanks all. planning to begin canary in sandbox next week. :thumbsup:
